items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Deemed 100 percent ahead of likely release
items.text:
Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his October 2024 knee injury and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dontayvion Wicks: Could be back this week
items.text:
Coach Nick Sirianni relayed Wednesday that he feels good about the chances of Wicks (ankle) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jalon Daniels: Getting first-team reps Wednesday
items.text:
Daniels is slated to take all of the first-teams reps Wednesday with Baker Mayfield (foot) sidelined for the Buccaneers' first Week 11 practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Trending toward being back this week
items.text:
Coach Nick Sirianni indicated Wednesday that he feels good about Smith (hamstring) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Milton: Retaining starting job
items.text:
Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
